SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1, COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_week) AS wks, MIN(fiscal_week) AS w0, MAX(fiscal_week) AS w1
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS line_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) AS loads, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, (n.store_id = 900) AS is_web, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT 'skus_not_exactly_one_current' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <> 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_lines_no_product_match', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales_lines_no_store_match', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store p ON p.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_no_product_match', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.product_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_no_store_match', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line f LEFT JOIN dim_store p ON p.store_key=f.store_key WHERE p.store_key IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_without_dispatched_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store_lines_matching_a_web_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_orders_dup_ids', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'return_dup_ids', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_orphan_sales_line', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL

),

    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND n.store_id <> 900 GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND r.store_id <> 900 AND r.store_id <> 999 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.mine, c.ctl, m.mine - c.ctl AS diff FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year) ORDER BY 1

SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       ty.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_category ty
JOIN by_category ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.category
